summary: Voyage AI (MongoDB) gives accounts their first 200 million tokens free on eligible current text-embedding and reranker models; examples include voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite and voyage-context-4, and the current pricing table also lists voyage-code-4 at 200M. Specialized -2 models have a 50M allowance; current prose also names voyage-multilingual-2. The official page prose and table differ on the code-model ID (voyage-code-3 versus voyage-code-4), so confirm the exact model and remaining allowance in the dashboard before calling. Current multimodal models receive 200M text tokens plus 150B pixels free. Free token credits do not apply to Batch API usage, which bills at the discounted batch rate.
claim_steps: Sign up for a Voyage AI account — no credit card required to start.
Create an API key in the dashboard.
Call the embeddings or rerank endpoints; the free token allowance applies automatically per account.

social_proof.title: Pricing — Voyage AI documentation
social_proof.text: The first 200 million tokens for voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4 ... are free for every account. Free token credits do not apply to Batch API usage.
